subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode

question: Should this broad interactive-parity branch land in core as one PR with default-on planning and new public/config surfaces, or should it be narrowed or split before merge?
rationale: The branch changes core interaction semantics, default tool exposure, public plugin SDK surface, and goal-driver configuration, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Fix blockers and split or narrow first
options.body: Require the approval-path and SDK-boundary fixes first, then review question, plan, and goal surfaces against maintainer-approved API and rollout boundaries.

options.title: Fix blockers and land as one feature
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the broad core direction after the P1 defects are fixed, upgrade behavior is documented, and live channel proof is supplied.

options.title: Pause in favor of the hub
options.body: Keep the roadmap issue as canonical and ask for smaller PRs with separate proof for each surface.

recommendation.title: Fix blockers and split or narrow first
recommendation.body: Require the approval-path and SDK-boundary fixes first, then review question, plan, and goal surfaces against maintainer-approved API and rollout boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant product-direction history is around strict-agentic/update_plan exposure and Codex-style runtime behavior.
